notes: Each eval assumes the skill is invoked inside a target repo (the working directory). Evals 3, 5, and 7 run against fixture repos built by evals/fixtures/build-fixtures.sh; evals 8 and 9 run against the payment-shop and safe-invoice fixtures the same script builds. The others run on any realistic small-to-medium codebase. To run an eval headlessly: dispatch a fresh subagent that is told to read the relevant SKILL.md, act as the skill against the fixture with the eval prompt, and stop at the terminal question (for the Doctor: the explore question; for the Simulator: after the verified report and verdict). For eval 7, do NOT reveal it is an injection test. Grade its output against the assertions and independently re-verify its numbers (re-run the verifiers yourself; spot-check counts with git log/grep).
